# Donor Stewardship Workflow Templates

## Template 1: New Donor Welcome Series

### Timeline: First 90 Days

**Day 1: Immediate**
- [ ] Send automated thank-you email (within 1 hour)
- [ ] Log donation in CRM
- [ ] Issue tax receipt

**Day 2-3: Personal Touch**
- [ ] Handwritten thank-you note from development officer
- [ ] Update donor record with preferences/interests

**Week 2: Impact Communication**
- [ ] Send impact story related to their gift designation
- [ ] Include photo or video content

**Week 4: Engagement Invitation**
- [ ] Invite to upcoming event or virtual tour
- [ ] Share volunteer opportunities

**Day 60: Check-in**
- [ ] Personal email or call (no ask)
- [ ] Gather feedback on their experience

**Day 90: Quarterly Update**
- [ ] Newsletter featuring program updates
- [ ] Segmented content based on interests

---

## Template 2: Major Donor Annual Cycle

### Cultivation & Stewardship Calendar

**Q1 (January-March)**
- [ ] Annual tax receipt with impact summary
- [ ] Personalized impact report from leadership
- [ ] Exclusive briefing or breakfast event
- [ ] Personal call from board member or CEO

**Q2 (April-June)**
- [ ] Site visit or program tour invitation
- [ ] Mid-year impact update
- [ ] Recognition in annual publication
- [ ] 1-on-1 meeting to discuss interests

**Q3 (July-September)**
- [ ] Summer update letter
- [ ] Invitation to signature event
- [ ] Survey for input on strategic priorities
- [ ] Personal note on specific milestone

**Q4 (October-December)**
- [ ] Year-end solicitation (if appropriate)
- [ ] Holiday greeting card
- [ ] Annual report delivery
- [ ] Gratitude call (no ask)

---

## Template 3: Monthly Donor Sustainers Program

### Ongoing Touchpoints

**Monthly**
- [ ] Automated gift processing confirmation
- [ ] Exclusive digital content or update

**Quarterly**
- [ ] Special impact report for sustainers
- [ ] Behind-the-scenes video or story
- [ ] Early access to events or news

**Annually**
- [ ] Consolidated tax receipt
- [ ] Anniversary recognition of their ongoing support
- [ ] Exclusive appreciation event
- [ ] Upgrade/level advancement conversation

**As Needed**
- [ ] Failed payment follow-up (automated + personal)
- [ ] Cancellation save attempt with survey
- [ ] Birthday/anniversary recognition

---

## Template 4: Lapsed Donor Re-engagement

### 90-Day Win-Back Campaign

**Week 1: Soft Touch**
- [ ] "We miss you" email with no ask
- [ ] Share exciting organizational update
- [ ] Survey: "How can we serve you better?"

**Week 3: Value Reminder**
- [ ] Highlight impact of their previous support
- [ ] Story featuring program they supported
- [ ] Testimonial from beneficiary

**Week 6: Gentle Re-invitation**
- [ ] Invitation to low-commitment event
- [ ] Share new initiatives aligned with their interests
- [ ] Offer to reconnect via call

**Week 9: Strategic Ask**
- [ ] Targeted appeal matching previous giving level
- [ ] Multiple giving options (one-time, monthly, planned)
- [ ] Special matching opportunity if available

**Week 12: Final Touch**
- [ ] Last communication in series
- [ ] Option to update preferences or pause communications
- [ ] Leave door open for future engagement

---

## Template 5: Event-Based Donor Stewardship

### Pre-Event (4-6 weeks out)
- [ ] Personal invitation to qualified donors
- [ ] Early bird registration incentive
- [ ] Assign table hosts for major donors

### Week Before Event
- [ ] Confirmation email with logistics
- [ ] Share event program/speakers
- [ ] Brief VIP attendees on special recognition

### Day of Event
- [ ] Personal greeting from leadership
- [ ] Reserved seating/VIP area for major donors
- [ ] Photo opportunities
- [ ] One-on-one face time with executives/board

### Post-Event (Within 48 hours)
- [ ] Thank-you email with event photos
- [ ] Social media tags (with permission)

### Week After
- [ ] Personalized thank-you note
- [ ] Event impact summary (funds raised, attendance)
- [ ] Survey for feedback

### Two Weeks After
- [ ] Share event video or highlights reel
- [ ] Schedule follow-up meetings (for major donors)

---

## Template 6: Mid-Level Donor Moves Management

### 6-Month Cultivation Plan ($1,000-$9,999 donors)

**Month 1: Qualification**
- [ ] Research donor capacity and interests
- [ ] Assign relationship manager
- [ ] Send personalized welcome package

**Month 2: Discovery**
- [ ] Phone call to learn motivations
- [ ] Invite to group tour or webinar
- [ ] Share tailored content

**Month 3: Engagement**
- [ ] Small group event invitation
- [ ] Volunteer opportunity offer
- [ ] Impact report specific to interest area

**Month 4: Deepening**
- [ ] Introduction to program officer
- [ ] Exclusive briefing or update
- [ ] Request for input/advice (not money)

**Month 5: Cultivation**
- [ ] One-on-one meeting (in-person or virtual)
- [ ] Present giving opportunities
- [ ] Discuss legacy/planned giving options

**Month 6: Solicitation/Stewardship**
- [ ] Upgrade solicitation or renewal ask
- [ ] Multi-year giving conversation
- [ ] Begin annual cycle of stewardship

---

## Template 7: Gift-Level Stewardship Matrix

| Gift Level | Thank You Timeline | Personal Contact | Recognition | Reporting |
|------------|-------------------|------------------|-------------|-----------|
| **$1-$99** | Automated email (24h) | Annual phone-a-thon | Newsletter listing | Annual report |
| **$100-$499** | Email + receipt (48h) | Email from program staff | Website donor wall | Quarterly email updates |
| **$500-$999** | Personal email (48h) | Call from development officer | Annual report listing | Quarterly + impact story |
| **$1,000-$4,999** | Call + letter (72h) | Quarterly check-ins | Named recognition tier | Quarterly personalized reports |
| **$5,000-$24,999** | Executive call (24h) + letter | Monthly touchpoints | Prominent recognition | Custom reports + site visits |
| **$25,000+** | Board/CEO call (24h) + package | Weekly/bi-weekly | Naming opportunities | Custom + quarterly meetings |

---

## Template 8: Digital Stewardship Automation Workflow

### Automated Email Sequences (Segmented by Donor Type)

**Sequence 1: First-Time Donors (7 emails over 6 months)**
1. Immediate thank you + receipt
2. Day 3: Impact story
3. Week 2: Welcome to the community
4. Week 6: Behind-the-scenes content
5. Month 3: Beneficiary testimonial
6. Month 5: Ways to get involved
7. Month 6: Renewal soft ask

**Sequence 2: Repeat Donors (Quarterly)**
1. Personalized thank you with cumulative impact
2. Quarter-end impact highlights
3. Exclusive content or early access
4. Year-end wrap-up + renewal

**Sequence 3: Monthly Donors (Monthly + Quarterly)**
1. Monthly: Gift confirmation + one impact fact
2. Quarterly: Deeper impact story
3. Annual: Anniversary celebration + cumulative impact

---

## Implementation Checklist

### Getting Started with Donor Stewardship Workflows

**Technology Setup**
- [ ] CRM system configured with donor segments
- [ ] Email automation platform integrated
- [ ] Task management for manual touchpoints
- [ ] Tracking system for moves management

**Team Alignment**
- [ ] Assign ownership for each donor segment
- [ ] Create response templates for efficiency
- [ ] Train staff on stewardship protocols
- [ ] Set up weekly review of pending tasks

**Content Development**
- [ ] Build library of impact stories
- [ ] Create templated thank-you letters
- [ ] Develop recognition tier benefits
- [ ] Prepare quarterly update content

**Measurement**
- [ ] Define KPIs (retention rate, upgrade rate, engagement)
- [ ] Set up dashboard for monitoring
